pairs: Et confestim mane consilium facientes summi sacerdotes cum senioribus, et scribis, et universo concilio, vincientes Jesum, duxerunt, et tradiderunt Pilato.

And immediately in the morning, after the leaders of the priests had taken counsel with the elders and the scribes and the entire council, binding Jesus, they led him away and delivered him to Pilate.
“You are the king of the Jews?”
Et accusabant eum summi sacerdotes in multis.
And the leaders of the priests accused him in many things.
See how greatly they accuse you.”
But Jesus continued to give no response,
Per diem autem festum solebat dimittere illis unum ex vinctis,
Now on the feast day, he was accustomed to release to them one of the prisoners,
But there was one called Barabbas,
who had committed murder in the sedition,
who was confined with those of the sedition.
And when the crowd had ascended,
cœpit rogare, sicut semper faciebat illis.
they began to petition him to do as he always did for them.
“Do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews?”
Sciebat enim quod per invidiam tradidissent eum summi sacerdotes.
For he knew that it was out of envy that the leaders of the priests had betrayed him.
Then the chief priests incited the crowd,
so that he would release Barabbas to them instead.
But Pilate, responding again, said to them:
ait illis: Quid ergo vultis faciam regi Judæorum?
“Then what do you want me to do with the king of the Jews?”
Yet truly, Pilate said to them:
But they cried out all the more,
Then Pilate, wishing to satisfy the people,
and he delivered Jesus, having severely scourged him,
Milites autem duxerunt eum in atrium prætorii,
Then the soldiers led him away to the court of the praetorium.
And they called together the entire cohort.
And they clothed him with purple.
et imponunt ei plectentes spineam coronam.
And platting a crown of thorns, they placed it on him.
And they began to salute him:
And they struck his head with a reed,
And after they had mocked him,
they stripped him of the purple,
and they clothed him in his own garments.
et educunt illum ut crucifigerent eum.
And they led him away, so that they might crucify him.
And they compelled a certain passerby,
who was arriving from the countryside,
the father of Alexander and Rufus,
Et perducunt illum in Golgotha locum:
And they led him through to the place called Golgotha,
Et dabant ei bibere myrrhatum vinum:
And they gave him wine with myrrh to drink.
But he did not accept it.
to see who would take what.
Now it was the third hour.
Et erat titulus causæ ejus inscriptus:
And the title of his case was written as:
Et cum eo crucifigunt duos latrones:
And with him they crucified two robbers:
and the other at his left.
“And with the iniquitous he was reputed.”
you who would destroy the temple of God,
and in three days rebuild it,
salvum fac temetipsum descendens de cruce.
save yourself by descending from the cross.”
And similarly the leaders of the priests,
He is not able to save himself.
Christus rex Israël descendat nunc de cruce,
Et qui cum eo crucifixi erant,
so that we may see and believe.”
Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.
And when the sixth hour arrived,
tenebræ factæ sunt per totam terram usque in horam nonam.
a darkness occurred over the entire earth, until the ninth hour.
Et hora nona exclamavit Jesus voce magna,
And at the ninth hour, Jesus cried out with a loud voice,
Deus meus, ut quid dereliquisti me?
And some of those standing near, upon hearing this,
running and filling a sponge with vinegar,
and placing it around a reed,
gave it to him to drink,
videamus si veniat Elias ad deponendum eum.
Let us see if Elijah will come to take him down.”
Jesus autem emissa voce magna expiravit.
Then Jesus, having emitted a loud cry, expired.
Et velum templi scissum est in duo,
And the veil of the temple was torn in two,
from the top to the bottom.
Then the centurion who stood opposite him,
seeing that he had expired while crying out in this way,
Vere hic homo Filius Dei erat.
this man was the Son of God.”
Erant autem et mulieres de longe aspicientes:
Now there were also women watching from a distance,
and Mary the mother of James the younger
quæ simul cum eo ascenderant Jerosolymam.
who had ascended along with him to Jerusalem.
Et cum jam sero esset factum (quia erat parasceve,
And when evening had now arrived (because it was the Preparation Day,
venit Joseph ab Arimathæa nobilis decurio,
qui et ipse erat exspectans regnum Dei,
who himself was also awaiting the kingdom of God.
And he boldly entered to Pilate and petitioned for the body of Jesus.
Pilatus autem mirabatur si jam obiisset.
But Pilate wondered if he had already died.
interrogavit eum si jam mortuus esset.
he questioned him as to whether he was already dead.
And when he had been informed by the centurion,
he gave the body to Joseph.
Then Joseph, having bought a fine linen cloth,
et posuit eum in monumento quod erat excisum de petra,
wrapped him in the fine linen and laid him in a sepulcher, which was hewn from a rock.
et advolvit lapidem ad ostium monumenti.
And he rolled a stone to the entrance of the tomb.
Maria autem Magdalene et Maria Joseph aspiciebant ubi poneretur.
Now Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph observed where he was laid.
